info.name: Mini Library System — Full API
info.description:
Full test suite for the Mini Library System backend (Books + Borrow/Return + Admin).

**Setup:** Import this collection AND `mini-library-system.postman_environment.json`.

The collection auto-refreshes the Firebase admin token before each request. Member/Member2 tokens are saved via the Auth folder sign-in requests.

**Run order (Collection Runner):**
1. 🔐 Auth — sign in all three users
2. 📚 Books — 11 tests (creates+deletes Clean Code book)
3. 🔄 Borrow / Return — 16 tests (full borrow lifecycle)
4. 🏛 Admin — 4 tests (admin borrow list + filters)

Total: 31 tests across 4 folders.

item.name: 🔄 Borrow / Return
item.description:
Full borrow/return lifecycle.

**Setup (run before this folder):** The Books folder must have run to populate {{book_id}} — but Borrow tests use their OWN books created in the prerequest scripts below. Run the Auth folder first so all three tokens are available.

**Run order:** B01→B16 in sequence. The Collection Runner handles this automatically.

After this request, you can verify the book status changed:

request.description:
Attempts a borrow when the member already holds MAX_ACTIVE_BORROWS active borrows.

**How to trigger this**: After B12, the member already has at least 1 active borrow (the 1-copy book from B11). To hit the limit you can use the test-borrow.sh script which creates enough books to fill the quota, then attempts one more.

In Postman this request tries to borrow the same book a second time after it was returned, so it will not necessarily hit the limit unless the quota is already full. Run test-borrow.sh for the full automated limit test.
Returns the 1-copy book borrow so the book becomes available again — needed before soft-delete.

item.name: 🏛 Admin
item.description:
Admin-only endpoints for managing the borrow system.

All requests require admin_token. Run AFTER the Borrow/Return folder so there is data to view.

request.description:
Member token on admin borrow list → 403.

Proves: requireRole(['admin','librarian']) blocks members from admin routes.

exec: pm.test('B14 — Borrow records have user and book populated', () => {

request.description:
Admin retrieves all borrow records across all users → 200 with paginated + populated list.

Optional filters (enable the disabled query params to test them):
- `status` — borrowed | returned
- `userId` — filter by specific user
- `bookId` — filter by specific book
- `overdue` — true returns only borrowed records past dueDate

Proves: adminList() returns all records regardless of user.

Admin filters borrow list by status=returned → 200 with only returned records.

Proves: adminList() correctly applies status filter in the repository query.

Admin filters for overdue borrows (borrowed + past dueDate) → 200.

In a new test environment borrows will not be overdue yet, so the list is empty — that is the correct behaviour. The test only validates the HTTP 200 shape.

Proves: repository resolves overdue filter as status=borrowed + dueDate<now.

item.name: 🧾 Fine Calculation
item.description:
Phase 3 fine calculation tests.

Fine is computed dynamically — never stored in the DB.

Formula: daysOverdue = Math.ceil((settledAt - dueDate) / MS_PER_DAY), fine = daysOverdue × FINE_PER_DAY (env var, default 1)

F01-F03: on-time return → fine = 0
F04-F06: overdue return → fine > 0 (requires DB backdating, see F04 description)
F07-F08: still-borrowed overdue → active history shows fine
F09: admin overdue list shows fine

Borrows the book again for the overdue scenario. Saves {{fine_borrow_id_b}}.

```
    {\$set: {dueDate: new Date(Date.now() - 47*60*60*1000)}}
  )"
```

Then run F05–F07 to assert fine > 0.
